Game Overview

Bubbly puts players into a hyper-casual experience centered on guide your bouncy bubble through a whimsical world, dodging persistent enemies and unpredictable waves. Time your jumps perfectly, as the bubble leaps on every touch. Survive rain from clouds and keep moving to beat the ever-changing challenges and extend your adventure. Can you master the bounce?
